title: An integral ring map does not raise Krull dimension
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a ring map of commutative rings such that $B$ is integral over $A$ (every element of $B$ is a root of a monic polynomial with coefficients in the image of $A$). Then $\dim B\le\dim A$ (Krull dimensions: suprema of lengths of chains of prime ideals), and every maximal ideal of $B$ lies over a maximal ideal of $A$.
